situation: A family group chat: parents and their two adult children.
topic: The eldest has told them they no longer believe in God; their devout mother is hurt and angry, and their father backs her.

text: Hey everyone 💛 just wanted to say we love each other whatever we believe. That's all
Thanks Mia 🙂
I'm not sure this is the time for that. I need some time with this.
Sorry mum just trying to help
Give it a few days Mia.
I'm not trying to hurt anyone. I just didn't want to keep pretending at Christmas. I thought it would go better than this.
Pretending? Is that what you think Christmas has been?
That's not what I meant.
Ok can we maybe talk about lunch. Who's doing ham
I'll do the ham. Ruth has the pavlova list.
I'll do the pavlova and the potatoes. Adam can bring the drinks.
Sure. Just tell me what you want.
[photo: brewery logo options, version 4 of 9]
Ooh the blue one
Client wants it more "premium". Which means worse.
Is anyone coming Christmas Eve? I need to know whether to buy the prawns.
I'm coming christmas eve if that's ok and I can help with prawns
Prawns are fine. Get the big ones.
Adam?
Yeah I'll come Christmas Eve too.
Mum I know you're upset. I'd still like to come.
We'll see you Thursday then. Christmas lunch is at twelve on Friday.
Ok gonna sleep. Love you all 💛🌙
night
Still awake. Sorry about today mum.
Thank you for saying sorry Adam. I'm not ready to talk about the rest yet.
Still coming Thursday. Your old room's made up.
Ok. Thanks mum 🙂
Do we want to do the pav on Friday morning or Thursday? Mine's off Thursday so I could do it then
Friday's fine. Oven's free after nine. Don't bring the cream over early, it splits.
Ok Friday morning then 👍
Drinks: prosecco, two slabs of the cider Dad likes, and a bottle of shiraz for Mum unless someone's changed their mind
Cider's fine. Not the shiraz, your mother's given that up.
I have not given up shiraz
Noted
[photo: brewery logo, version 5 of 9]
Ok this one is less bad 😂
Client said "more crest". I don't know what a crest is for beer
Is anyone bringing ice cream for after or is it just pav
Just pav.
Adam what time are you getting to ours Thursday
Probably after five, I've got a logo handover in the afternoon
Ok
I'm not trying to make Christmas a fight. I'll be quiet about it if that's what you want
Nobody's asking you to be quiet. Get some sleep.
💛 night all 🌙
night
Morning. Going past Bunnings after work if anyone needs anything for Friday.
Morning nothing from bunnings thanks. Need a coffee before I can think about christmas
Logo handover's at 3 if anyone wants to say it was a team effort
The blue one
You were right. Don't tell the client it was your idea.
Adam will you bring the esky or should Colin get it out of the shed
I'll bring it. Is it the blue one
Shed. Top shelf behind the paint tins. Check it's dry first.
Sorry meeting went 2 hrs bc a client decided the whole app should be "warmer". Warmer!! We are on a grey palette 😩
What does warmer mean on a grey palette
No idea. We're doing an orange button and a sad emoji
Ruth's bought the prawns. Eleven kilos
Four kilos. The rest is for Adam to take home.
She's joking
I am not
Mum can I ask something about Thursday. Not a fight
Ask
Do you want me to say grace or would you rather I didn't
I'd like you to sit at the table. We can talk about grace later.
ok
Ok I'm off to bed early, have a 7am. Night 💛🌙
can't sleep.
Mum I know you said later. I just don't want Christmas to be the thing everyone's waiting on
Go to bed Adam.
Ok
Night
